purpose: Build ShredDouble: an algorithmic rhythm doubler that synthesizes convincing double-tracked width from a single take. C++20/JUCE plugin targeting VST3, CLAP, LV2, and Standalone. V=2 or 4 virtual voices, each fed the mono source through an independent chain of (a) bounded mean-reverting random-walk timing + pitch humanization (no LFO — stochastic and non-periodic by design), (b) per-voice decorrelation via coprime Schroeder allpass diffusion + subtle EQ tilt, and (c) the same shared-LP mono-safety crossover as ShredWidth so lows stay centered under mono fold-down. Deterministic given a seed (masterSeed stored in state; Re-roll generates a new seed on demand). Reuses ShredWidth's PitchShifter, DelayLineFrac, MonoSafetyCrossover, WidthProcessor, and GUI metering components verbatim. Full product specification in ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md. Section 16 open decisions are materialized at their defaults (D3 Rate=correlation-time / Tightness=depth-macro remap confirmed, default V=2, Studio/Live included, Width+OutTrim parity included, Re-roll as GUI button with masterSeed in state, default Mix 50%, no AU, shared files copied from ShredWidth).
async_strategy: Phases run sequentially. Within each phase, tasks with disjoint write paths run in parallel waves. Fan-in tasks (processBlock wiring, editor assembly, CMakeLists source registration) depend on all upstream tasks in the same phase and are the sole owner of CMakeLists.txt, PluginProcessor, and PluginEditor within that phase. The C++ language adapter provides cmake/ctest verification inference from CMakeLists.txt once the build system exists, so task verification_commands arrays are left empty. Real build, ctest, RT-safety, and pluginval verification run in phase e via scripts that resolve cmake through build_all.sh (CLion-bundled cmake; not on PATH). Eight DSP and GUI files are reused verbatim from ShredWidth and copied into Source/ in phase a.

phases.goal:
New DSP primitives: seeded random walk, allpass decorrelation, EQ tilt, and the per-voice container.

See ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md sections 4.3 (random walk), 4.5 (allpass+tilt), 4.2 (voice architecture), 6 (smoothing), 7 (RT-safety), and 8 (memory). All new DSP classes expose prepare(spec)/process(...)/reset() and allocate nothing outside prepare.

RandomWalk: seeded xoshiro256++ (or xorshift128+) PRNG per stream, deterministic via splitmix64(masterSeed XOR voiceIdx XOR axisTag). One-pole Ornstein-Uhlenbeck walk with alpha = 1 - exp(-1/(tau_c * fs)), variance-normalized by u_tilde = u / sqrt(alpha/(2-alpha)). Generates at control-rate hop H=32 samples and linearly interpolates to audio rate. Tightness scales depth: excursion *= (1-T). Hard clamps: delay [tau_min,tau_max]=[10,35] ms, pitch [-C_max,+C_max]. PRNG is POD, no locks, no std::random_device on audio thread.

AllpassChain: N_ap=4 cascaded first-order Schroeder allpasses per voice. y(n) = -g*x(n) + x(n-M) + g*y(n-M), g~0.6. Per-voice per-stage delays M are mutually coprime and distinct across voices (e.g. V1={13,29,47,71}, V2={17,37,53,79}, V3={19,41,59,83}, V4={23,43,61,89} samples at 48 kHz, scaled by sampleRate). Magnitude-flat, phase-dispersive. Total group delay stays small (a few ms).

TiltFilter: per-voice first-order tilt shelf (low-shelf boost / high-shelf cut of equal small magnitude, pivot ~700 Hz). Distinct per voice (V1 +1.5 dB bright, V2 -1.5 dB dark, V3 +0.8, V4 -0.8). Spectral decorrelation complement to the phase decorrelation.

Voice: container owning 2 RandomWalks (delay axis + pitch axis), 1 PitchShifter (reused), 1 DelayLineFrac (reused), 1 AllpassChain, 1 TiltFilter, pan coefficients (panL, panR via constant-power pan law), and nominalDelayMs. Per-sample process: advance walks (at hop boundaries), feed interpolated deltaC into PitchShifter, feed interpolated tau into DelayLineFrac, chain through AllpassChain and TiltFilter, apply pan and accumulate into wet L/R.
phases.async_notes: Wave 1: b.1 (RandomWalk), b.2 (AllpassChain), and b.3 (TiltFilter) are all independent (disjoint files). Wave 2: b.4 (Voice) depends on b.1, b.2, b.3 (Voice includes and owns instances of all three). Wave 3: b.5 (TestMain + tests + CMakeLists; sole CMakeLists owner) depends on b.1, b.2, b.3, b.4.

phases.goal:
Engine orchestration, metering tap, processBlock integration, and comprehensive tests.

See ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md sections 3 (signal flow), 4.1 (mono source), 4.6 (panning/summation), 4.7 (crossover + width), 4.8 (dry/wet mix), 4.9 (latency/PDC), 4.10 (seeding/Re-roll), 7 (RT-safety), 9.5 (audio->UI transport), and 14 (verification).

MeterTap: audio-thread Pearson correlation rho of output L/R, one-pole smoothed ~300 ms, published as std::atomic<float>; decimated output L/R pairs pushed into juce::AbstractFifo (~4096 frames) for goniometer; per-voice tau_v and deltaC_v published as 2*V std::atomic<float> values written at hop rate for DriftDisplay. No lock, allocation, or String on push path.

ShredDoubleEngine: owns V=4 Voice objects (voices 3-4 muted/ramped when voiceCount==2 via masked crossfade, D6), one shared MonoSafetyCrossover (shared LP from dry mono x, independent HP per wet accumulator, inverted HP polarity), one WidthProcessor, dry-align delay, and MeterTap. masterSeed management: seed(uint64) reseeds all voice/axis PRNGs via splitmix64 and resets walks to nominal means; Re-roll calls seed(newSeed). Per-sample path: mono source x -> fan to V voices (each: walk advance at hop, pitch shift, drifting delay, allpass, tilt, pan accumulate) -> wet L/R summation -> HP(wet) + shared LP(x) assembly -> M/S width -> equal-gain dry/wet mix against dry delayed by PDC. Latency-mode switch repoints pre-allocated buffers with masked crossfade (no realloc, D6/D9).

PluginProcessor processBlock: ScopedNoDenormals; read smoothed parameters (crossover coeffs per block; spreads, pans, width, mix per sample; humanRate/tightness recompute alpha/depth per block); call engine.process; push final output to MeterTap; report latency = L/2 via setLatencySamples, updateHostDisplay on mode switch. Register new sources in CMakeLists.

Tests split into two tasks: (1) seeding and determinism (same seed = bit-identical, different seed = different, Re-roll generates distinct seed); (2) integration checks (bypass null, Mix=0 passthrough, mono-lows invariant, walk bounds, tightness monotonicity, decorrelation, latency).

phases.goal:
GUI: per-voice drift display and full editor layout.

See ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md section 9 (GUI and visualizations) and section 13 (file structure). CustomLookAndFeel, RotarySlider, GoniometerComponent, and CorrelationMeter are reused from ShredWidth (copied in phase a). The only new GUI component is DriftDisplay.

DriftDisplay: the signature ShredDouble diagnostic. A 2-D scatter field with X-axis = each voice's current timing offset relative to nominal (ms) and Y-axis = current pitch offset (cents). One color-coded marker per active voice, each trailing a short fading history so you see the four performers breathing independently. Polls 2*V std::atomic<float> values (tau_v, deltaC_v) from MeterTap at 30-60 Hz via the UI Timer. Voices 3-4 markers hidden when voiceCount==2.

PluginEditor full layout: header (plugin name, preset selector, A/B compare, Re-roll button wired to StateManager::reroll(), bypass LED); voice section (voiceCount segmented 2/4 with per-voice pan strips for active voices); humanization section (Timing Spread, Pitch Spread, Humanization Rate, Tightness rotaries); global section (Low Mono Crossover, Stereo Width, Mix, Output Trim, Latency Mode segmented); metering column (GoniometerComponent top, CorrelationMeter middle, DriftDisplay bottom). Wire APVTS SliderAttachments, Timer at 30-60 Hz, ResizableCornerComponent with constrained aspect, window size in value tree state. Apply CustomLookAndFeel. Register GUI sources in CMakeLists.

Factory presets, correctness tests, verification scripts, and release documentation.

See ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md section 12 (presets), section 14 (verification and test plan), section 15 (build integration), and section 16 (open decisions, all defaulted).

Factory presets as APVTS XML with fixed masterSeed per preset (regression fixtures), embedded via BinaryData: Tight Metal Quad (V4, Timing 4 ms, Pitch 4 c, Rate 40, Tightness 75%, Xover 200 Hz, Pan 100/100/60/60, Mix 60%); Wide Double (V2, 6/5/50/50%, 180 Hz, 100/100, 50%); Loose Garage Double (V2, 12/8/70/20%, 150 Hz, 55%); Subtle Thickener (V2, 3/3/30/80%, 250 Hz, 35%); Live Quad Tracking (Live, V4, 5/4/45/65%, 50%).

Correctness tests: pitch accuracy (FFT shifted output, assert peak within tolerance of f*2^(deltaC/1200)); correlation sanity (Width=200% drops rho; Width=0 rho~1; mono-safe sub-f_cross). Register preset BinaryData and test target in CMakeLists.

Verification scripts: RT-safety grep gate (processBlock forbidden calls + ScopedNoDenormals + assert no std::random_device on audio thread); pluginval at strictness 8+ on VST3/CLAP with LV2/Standalone smoke-load. Scripts resolve cmake via build_all.sh / CLion.

Documentation: verification checklist covering section 14 CI-runnable checks (RT-safety, seed-determinism, bypass, Mix=0, mono-lows, walk bounds, correlation-time sanity, voice decorrelation, tightness monotonicity, latency, pluginval) with honest note that ear-pass and host matrix are manual; user manual covering seeding/Re-roll workflow, D3 Rate/Tightness remap explanation, voice-count and latencyMode automation caveats, LV2 host notes.
